if (state.collectedHosts.size > 0) sourceCount++; btnCompare.innerText = `교차 비교 실행 (${Math.max(2, sourceCount)}개 소스)`; updateGuideTargetsView(); } txtDetail.oninput = updateCountsAndButton; txtIncident.oninput = updateCountsAndButton; txtTarget.oninput = updateCountsAndButton; btnResetAwx.onclick = () => { state.collectedHosts.clear(); state.excludedHosts = []; state.rawCount = 0; awxSummaryEl.innerHTML = ''; updateCountsAndButton(); }; btnPage.onclick = () => { const filters = getExcludeFilters(inputExclude.value.trim()); document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr').forEach(tr => { const nameEl = tr.querySelector('td[data-label="이름"] a, td[data-label="Name"] a, td a[href*="/hosts/"]') || tr.querySelector('td:nth-child(2) a'); if (nameEl) { const h = nameEl.innerText.trim().toLowerCase(); if (h) { if (isHostExcluded(h, filters)) { state.collectedHosts.delete(h); if (!state.excludedHosts.includes(h)) { state.excludedHosts.push(h); } } else { state.excludedHosts = state.excludedHosts.filter(x => x !== h); state.collectedHosts.add(h); } } } }); state.rawCount = state.collectedHosts.size + state.excludedHosts.length; renderAwxSummary(); updateCountsAndButton(); }; async function runCollectAll() { btnCollectAll.disabled = true; btnCollectAll.innerText = '수집 중...'; const currentContext = getContext(); const filters = getExcludeFilters(inputExclude.value.trim()); state.collectedHosts.clear(); state.excludedHosts = []; try { let nextUrl = currentContext.url; while (nextUrl) { const res = await fetch(nextUrl); const data = await res.json(); if (data.results) { data.results.forEach(item => { const name = item.name.trim().toLowerCase(); if (isHostExcluded(name, filters)) { if (!state.excludedHosts.includes(name)) { state.excludedHosts.push(name); } } else { state.collectedHosts.add(name); } }); } nextUrl = data.next; } state.rawCount = state.collectedHosts.size + state.excludedHosts.length; renderAwxSummary(); } catch (err) { awxSummaryEl.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#dc2626; font-weight:600;">수집 실패: ${err.message}</span>`; } finally { btnCollectAll.disabled = false; btnCollectAll.innerText = '현재 인벤토리 전체 수집'; updateCountsAndButton(); } return state.collectedHosts.size; } btnCollectAll.onclick = runCollectAll; window.awxRunCollectAll = runCollectAll; function renderAwxSummary() { if (state.rawCount === 0) { awxSummaryEl.innerHTML = ''; return; } const exCount = state.excludedHosts.length; if (exCount > 0) { awxSummaryEl.innerHTML = ` <div style="font-weight:700; color:#b45309; margin-top:4px; font-size:12px;"> ${state.rawCount}대 중 ${exCount}대 제외됨 (수집 대상: ${state.collectedHosts.size}대) </div> <div class="awx-vld-mono" style="font-size:11.5px; color:#374151; margin-top:3px; word-break:break-all; background:#ffffff; padding:5px 7px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #e5e7eb;"> ${state.excludedHosts.join(' ')} </div> `; } else { awxSummaryEl.innerHTML = `<div style="color:#111827; margin-top:3px; font-weight:500;">${state.collectedHosts.size}대 수집 완료 (제외 0대)</div>`; } } function doCompare() { const detailList = parseHostText(txtDetail.value); const incidentList = parseHostText(txtIncident.value); const targetList = parseHostText(txtTarget.value); const awxList = Array.from(state.collectedHosts); if (detailList.length === 0 || incidentList.length === 0) { resultBox.style.display = 'block'; resultBox.style.background = '#fef2f2'; resultBox.style.borderColor = '#fca5a5'; resultBox.innerHTML = ` <div style="font-weight:700; color:#dc2626; margin-bottom:4px; font-size:13px;">오류: 필수 입력 항목 누락</div> <div style="color:#991b1b; font-size:12px;"> 상세목록현황과 인시던트 호스트는 필수 입력 대상입니다. 두 입력창에 호스트를 입력해주세요. </div> `; return; } const activeSources = []; activeSources.push({ id: 'detail', name: '상세목록현황', hosts: new Set(detailList) }); activeSources.push({ id: 'incident', name: '인시던트', hosts: new Set(incidentList) }); if (targetList.length > 0) { activeSources.push({ id: 'target', name: '작업대상', hosts: new Set(targetList) }); } if (awxList.length > 0) { activeSources.push({ id: 'awx', name: 'AWX 수집 목록', hosts: new Set(awxList) }); } const unionSet = new Set(); activeSources.forEach(s => s.hosts.forEach(h => unionSet.add(h))); let isAllMatch = true; const diffs = []; activeSources.forEach(source => { const missingInSource = []; unionSet.forEach(h => { if (!source.hosts.has(h)) missingInSource.push(h); }); if (missingInSource.length > 0) { isAllMatch = false; diffs.push({ sourceName: source.name, sourceCount: source.hosts.size, missingCount: missingInSource.length, missingList: missingInSource }); } }); let awxSpecialReport = ''; if (state.collectedHosts.size > 0) { const targetRef = new Set([...detailList, ...incidentList]); const notInTargetFromAwx = []; state.collectedHosts.forEach(h => { if (!targetRef.has(h)) notInTargetFromAwx.push(h); }); if (notInTargetFromAwx.length > 0) { isAllMatch = false; const toggleId = 'awx-toggle-' + Date.now(); awxSpecialReport = ` <div style="margin-top:8px; padding:9px 11px; background:#fff1f2; border:1px solid #fecdd3; border-radius:5px;"> <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;"> <span style="font-weight:700; color:#be123c; font-size:12px;">대상에 없음: ${notInTargetFromAwx.length}대 (AWX ${state.collectedHosts.size}대 중 ${targetRef.size}대만 존재)</span> <button id="btn-${toggleId}" class="awx-vld-btn awx-vld-btn-secondary awx-vld-btn-sm" style="border-color:#f43f5e; color:#be123c;">명단 펼치기</button> </div> <div id="${toggleId}" class="awx-vld-mono" style="display:none; margin-top:7px; max-height:120px; overflow-y:auto; font-size:11.5px; color:#881337; background:#ffffff; padding:8px; border:1px solid #fda4af; border-radius:4px; word-break:break-all;"> ${notInTargetFromAwx.join(' ')} </div> </div> `; } } resultBox.style.display = 'block'; const resultGuideId = 'res-guide-toggle-' + Date.now(); const guideHosts = getGuideTargetHosts(txtIncident.value, txtTarget.value, txtDetail.value); const mandatoryCommentHtml = ` <div style="margin-top:10px; padding:9px 11px; background:#f8fafc; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:5px; color:#0f172a;"> <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:4px;"> <span style="font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700; color:#334155;">작업 권장 안내</span> <button id="btn-${resultGuideId}" class="awx-vld-btn awx-vld-btn-secondary awx-vld-btn-sm" style="padding:2px 7px; font-size:11px;">펼치기</button> </div> <div class="awx-vld-mono" style="font-size:11.5px; word-break:break-all;"> 인시던트의 작업대상을 복사해서 붙여넣기를 권장합니다.vim [작업대상 파일] -&gt; esc -&gt; :set paste 입력(붙여넣기 모드) -&gt; 붙여넣기 </div> <div id="${resultGuideId}" class="awx-vld-mono" style="display:none; margin-top:7px; max-height:120px; overflow-y:auto; background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:4px; padding:7px; font-size:11.5px; color:#111827; white-space:pre-wrap; word-break:break-all;">${guideHosts.join('\n')}</div> </div> `; if (isAllMatch) { resultBox.style.background = '#f0fdf4'; resultBox.style.borderColor = '#86efac'; resultBox.innerHTML = ` <div style="font-weight:700; color:#15803d; font-size:13.5px; margin-bottom:6px;"> [MATCH] 비교 대상 전수 일치 확인 완료 </div> <div style="color:#166534; font-size:12px;"> • 참여 소스: <b>${activeSources.map(s => `${s.name}(${s.hosts.size}대)`).join(', ')}</b><br> • 불일치 및 누락 호스트: <b>0대</b> ${state.excludedHosts.length > 0 ? `<br>• AWX 제외: <b>${state.rawCount}대 중 ${state.excludedHosts.length}대 제외됨</b> (${state.excludedHosts.join(' ')})` : ''} </div> ${mandatoryCommentHtml} `; } else { resultBox.style.background = '#fef2f2'; resultBox.style.borderColor = '#fca5a5'; let diffHtml = ''; diffs.forEach((d, idx) => { const tid = `diff-toggle-${idx}-${Date.now()}`; diffHtml += ` <div style="margin-top:6px; padding:8px 10px; background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #fecaca; border-radius:5px;"> <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;"> <span style="font-weight:700; color:#991b1b; font-size:12px;">• ${d.sourceName}: 누락 ${d.missingCount}대 (보유: ${d.sourceCount}대)</span> <button id="btn-${tid}" class="awx-vld-btn awx-vld-btn-secondary awx-vld-btn-sm">명단 펼치기</button> </div> <div id="${tid}" class="awx-vld-mono" style="display:none; margin-top:6px; max-height:100px; overflow-y:auto; font-size:11.5px; color:#b91c1c; background:#fef2f2; padding:7px; border-radius:4px; word-break:break-all;"> ${d.missingList.join(' ')} </div> </div> `; }); resultBox.innerHTML = ` <div style="font-weight:700; color:#dc2626; font-size:13.5px; margin-bottom:4px;"> [MISMATCH] 소스 간 불일치 감지 (${activeSources.length}개 소스 비교) </div> <div style="color:#7f1d1d; font-size:12px; margin-bottom:6px;"> 참여 소스 현황: ${activeSources.map(s => `<b>${s.name}</b>(${s.hosts.size}대)`).join(' vs ')} </div> ${awxSpecialReport} ${diffHtml} ${mandatoryCommentHtml} `; } resultBox.querySelectorAll('button[id^="btn-"]').forEach(btn => { btn.onclick = () => { const targetId = btn.id.replace('btn-', ''); const targetEl = rootDoc.getElementById(targetId); if (targetEl) { const isHidden = targetEl.style.display === 'none'; targetEl.style.display = isHidden ? 'block' : 'none'; if (targetId.startsWith('res-guide-toggle-')) { btn.innerText = isHidden ? '접기' : '펼치기'; } else { btn.innerText = isHidden ? '명단 접기' : '명단 펼치기'; } } }; }); } btnCompare.onclick = doCompare; window.awxDoCompare = doCompare; updateCountsAndButton(); renderAwxSummary(); applyPinState(); } bindEvents(document, false, null); })();
